basic_info.description: One-of-a-kind property with a spacious house and a big fully detached studio in the backyard on a special block of Noe Valley. The unique studio features an open layout with steel beams and 4 large skylights. It's an incredible airy light-filled space with high ceilings wonderful for artists and for working in. The main level of the house has an open living and dining room as well as a nice-sized eat-in kitchen. There is a breakfast nook, good cabinet space, and a transom window. Direct access to a staircase to the backyard from the kitchen. The upper level has 2 comfortable bedrooms and a bathroom with a skylight. The lower level offers a lot of flexible space, its own entry, and walk-out access to the backyard. The backyard has an inviting garden with beautiful plants, sitting areas, and custom tile accents. Curb appeal, great natural light, nice windows, pleasant outlooks, gorgeous hardwood floors, ample storage space, and preserved period details complete this home. Quintessential San Francisco charm and character. About 6 blocks from the beloved 24th St. corridor. By numerous popular restaurants, cafes, and shops. Near Bernal Heights, the Mission, and Glen Park. This home is truly 1 of 1. It has been loved by the owners for decades and hasn't been on the market in 40 years.
